sentences.en: NYU-- the school all you guys chose to attend-- is going out of its way to honor this distinguished group. What will they honor you guys for someday? What will they honor you for someday?
sentences.zh: 纽约大学——你们所有人选择就读的学校——正在竭尽全力向这个杰出的群体致敬。有一天他们会用什么来表彰你们呢？有一天他们会用什么来荣耀你？

sentences.en: Speaking to you guys today is charge me up.

sentences.zh: 毕业生们，你们可能认为你们的时间和教育已经结束，但今天你们离开这里后，我要求你们把你们的行为公之于众。刺激对更好、更容易获得的教育的需求。

sentences.en: Engage and inspire whether on an individual level or loudly within your communities. Talk about your accomplishments.
sentences.zh: 无论是在个人层面还是在社区中大声参与和激励。谈谈你的成就。

sentences.en: It's very important. Talk about your accomplishments. Be humble, but not too humble. Don't be invisible.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要。谈谈你的成就。要谦虚，但不要太谦虚。不要看不见。
